item.text: I’m collecting the strongest 2022 international-conduct evidence around Taiwan coercion, military signaling, peace-channel behavior, and official public justification. The local prior already covers the no-war/UCDP baseline, so I’m not re-fetching those structured datasets; I’m only pulling narrative and primary sources that show ruler-attributed choices.
